results.overview: An unexpected visit from an old pen pal disrupts the life of a young couple.

results.overview: Years after a family was torn apart by a son’s love marriage, an elderly grandmother longs to reunite with her late second son’s only child, whose arrival slowly begins to heal old wounds and bring the fractured family back together.

results.overview: Giuseppe is carried by passing passions—singing, insects, private investigation, embroidery—until one day in the park, he meets a quiet balloon seller. Something about her makes him pause.

results.title: Sonaggios
results.overview: In the Sardinian town of Tonara, where the ancient art of crafting cowbells teeters on the edge of extinction, a family battles to preserve their heritage, passing down skills to a new generation while grappling with personal struggles and the pull of modernity. English subtitles.

results.title: Last Call
results.overview: A lesbian couple must rely on a jaded bartender to work through their recent-breakup bubble to survive a sudden zombie attack inside a dying Queer bar.

results.title: Saving the Christmas Ranch
results.overview: When the accountant for Carrie Williams’ family’s Christmas lodge makes off with all their money, Carrie has just two days to come up with nine months of missing mortgage payments or be foreclosed upon. Charming developer John Dunn has been calling Carrie from afar for a while, and now he’s here in person to make an offer on the ranch she can hardly refuse. Can Carrie raise enough funds before the deadline to save her home? Or will she be forced to sell to John, who hasn’t been entirely truthful about how he came to be there.

results.title: Tears in Kuala Lumpur
results.overview: Set against the backdrop of an ever-evolving Malaysian capital, a contemplative protagonist navigates the emotional debris of a dissolved relationship through a series of surreal, elegiac recollections that blur the line between historical memory and psychological dreamscape.

results.title: All That We Love
results.overview: Following the death of her family dog, Emma finds herself at a crossroads where grief and release play together: a midlife awakening is now in full throttle, and those closest to Emma feel the impact, including her best friend Stan  and her rambunctious daughter Maggie. To make matters more complicated and ripe for comedic mishaps, Emma's estranged ex-husband Andy returns to the city from Singapore down on his professional luck and aiming to rekindle things with his lost love.

results.title: Cloud Fish
results.overview: A very tiny fish sails in a vast underwater city. Is he too small to see the world?

results.title: Paris Opera Ballet: The Nutcracker
results.original_title: Ballet de l’Opéra de Paris: Casse-Noisette
results.overview: On Christmas Eve, young Clara receives a nutcracker doll and drifts into a dream where toys come alive. Guided by the transformed nutcracker prince, she moves through a world of toy soldiers, rats, and magical creatures, facing her fears and desires. Snowflakes, flowers, and fantastical landscapes frame a vivid choreography set to Tchaikovsky’s iconic score.

results.original_title: Single Black Female 3: The Final Chapter
results.overview: After being wrongfully arrested for murder, Monica has finally been proven innocent. All charges have been dropped and the police have shifted their focus to Simone, who has seeming disappeared. But Simone is bonding with her daughter Joy.
